_comment: 20-minute (1200 s) single-shot capture of a slow ECM waveform. sample_rate is pinned at 10 S/s (plenty for a 1 mHz signal, keeps the record small). AUTO trigger so the acquisition starts immediately (little delay). NOTE: this needs a 120 s/div window, which exceeds the Keysight DSO-X 3034G max (50 s/div) - use the Tektronix MSO24 for this capture. CH1: 1 V/div DC 1 MOhm. The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. WINDOW: pass duration_s=1200 to configure_scope for this test (1200 s total = 120 s/div x 10; with the pinned 10 S/s that is 12000 points).
name: ecm_20min
